overview: Premium commercial real estate consulting website for Rama Properties, based in Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi. Positions them as a high-end commercial property and investment advisory firm targeting business owners, office seekers, and investors.
features: Cinematic hero with animated overlay and trust strip
Interactive property category cards with hover effects
Featured properties premium grid with overlay CTAs
Market insights with Recharts data visualizations
Consultation inquiry form with backend storage
Floating WhatsApp, Call, and Consultation action buttons
Sticky navbar with logo and premium blur effect
Mobile-first responsive design with Motion.js animations
